projects.name: Conduit — CI/CD Visibility Platform (Ongoing)
projects.summary: A centralized dashboard for monitoring CI/CD pipelines and Docker container infrastructure in real time.
features: Real-time CI/CD pipeline monitoring and visual dashboard telemetry
Deep Docker integration for tracking container logs, status, and health metrics
Secure role-based user authentication and access controls
Responsive, utility-first UI for cross-device pipeline monitoring

projects.name: Internship LMS
projects.summary: A role-based Learning Management System (LMS) tailored for internship management, with Admin, Mentor, and Intern portals.
features: Role-based dashboards for Admin, Mentor, and Intern
Session management with recordings and study material uploads
Attendance tracking and real-time session overview
Offer letter and certificate generation interface
Auth and data layer powered by Supabase

projects.name: CodeTalk
projects.summary: CodeTalk is a smart web app that uses AI (LLaMA 3.3 70B & Gemini) to assist developers with coding, debugging, and translating code.
features: AI-powered code generation
Code & error analysis
Image to UI code via Gemini
Multilingual code translation
Voice command integration
Real-time suggestions & debugging

projects.name: Cropcare
projects.summary: An AI-powered platform to support farmers with real-time crop disease detection, weather forecasts, and agriculture insights.
features: AI chatbot with voice/text support in regional languages
Upload crop images to detect diseases using computer vision
Real-time location-based weather forecasts
Crop calendar with reminders
Track current market prices in local markets

projects.name: Alpha
projects.summary: An AI-powered interview preparation and simulation platform featuring Learning and Simulation phases.
features: Learning Phase: Aptitude, Group Discussion (GD), and Personal Interview (PI) training
Simulation Phase: complete AI-led simulated interview pipeline
GD practice with real-time AI agents and speech feedback
PI prep with coding screen sharing and response analysis
Detailed performance dashboard and weak point detection

projects.name: Mental Health Chatbot
projects.summary: Conversational AI designed to provide emotional support, coping tips, and resources for mental well-being.
features: Real-time mental health conversation
Empathetic, non-judgmental AI responses
Provides coping strategies and stress/anxiety management advice
Privacy-focused text interactions

projects.name: E-plantShopping
projects.summary: Online e-commerce platform for browsing, filtering, and ordering a variety of plants.
features: Plant catalog with search, filters, and categories
Cart and order management features
Admin dashboard for product management
Secure login and signup integration

projects.name: WebCapture
projects.summary: Streamlined web scraping tool designed to extract images and hyperlinks from web domains.
features: Extracts images and links from individual pages and full domains
Customizable search and export options (CSV, JSON)
Built-in analytics for scraped pages

projects.name: Developer Portfolio v1
projects.summary: Minimal and clean personal portfolio website presenting developer background and experience.
features: Responsive, minimal presentation structure
Built using React and Tailwind CSS
Styled using shadcn/ui components

projects.name: Developer Portfolio v2 (3D)
projects.summary: 3D Interactive portfolio showcasing work experiences and skills using Three.js.
features: 3D animations and interactive models
Uses React Three Fiber (R3F) and Three.js
Responsive styling and custom overlays
